title: THE FRONTIER WEEK · The saloon sign
venue: the Newport paper · a western week the editor cut · Box 3
logline: The saloon with a painted sign — the Lanes' fifteen letters, hand-lettered on a board — and a painter on a ladder with one letter left, and the stranger below asking which letter he'd leave out if he had to. The painter says the S. The stranger says that's the one they always lose. Nobody in 2000 knows what he means.
